verdict.rationale: The evidence documents developer building blocks: a REST API over expenses, payments, journal entries and reports, plus webhooks an external agent could use to watch ledger activity. Nothing shows FreshBooks itself monitoring the ledger, detecting spend anomalies or flagging duplicate transactions before close. Bank-reconciliation automation and bookkeeping services are adjacent features and do not establish anomaly or duplicate detection.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor the ledger and flag anomalies in spend or duplicate transactions before the close
